During the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]''' served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He commanded his [[Warship/Legends|vessel]] at the [[Battle over Korriban|second battle]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], wherein he unsuccessfully requested aid from the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]].
